name: Chikan Sen'you Sharyou 2 ~Houfuku no Chijoku Densha~
source:
Takumi is a professional train molester. But one day, he is arrested by police because a girl, whom he doesn't know, denounces him to the police as a train molester. After harsh investigation, he is somehow released. He's lost everything.... His grudge gradually grows bigger.... His revenge life starts like this....

[From ErogeShop]
